stories.title: Trump says a deal to end war with Iran is near, but many questions remain
stories.summary: U.S. and Iran are nearing a tentative deal to end the conflict, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and curb Tehran's uranium stockpile — though major details remain unresolved.

stories.title: Speed of Ebola outbreak challenges global health workers in wake of U.S. funding cuts
stories.summary: There have been more than 900 suspected and confirmed cases of Ebola, resulting in more than 180 deaths. It's the first major outbreak the Trump Administration drastically cut health aid programs.

stories.title: Cineplexity: The state of Star Wars
stories.summary: NPR's Star Wars nerds talk about whether the franchise still has the juice, as 'Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu' hits the cinemas.

stories.title: Religious leaders, lawmakers push for $1 billion to secure houses of worship
stories.summary: There's an effort on Capitol Hill to increase funding for the Nonprofit Security Grant Program, which awards funding to houses of worship to harden their defenses. In 2024, roughly a third of those who applied actually received funding.

stories.title: Kill your lawn, plant native flowers
stories.summary: Life Kit explains the benfits of swapping your lawn for a native plant garden

stories.title: Remains of lost arctic explorers identified with DNA, nearly two centuries later
stories.summary: New research shines a light on the lost Franklin Expedition, a 19th century voyage to the Canadian Arctic gone awry.
